description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelTicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BookingDetails" name="Route, date, time, personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket by email or SMS"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PostTravelFeedback" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelBooking"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" sourceRef="SendTask_BookingDetails" targetRef="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketEmail" name="Ticket by email" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketEmail" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketSMS" name="Ticket by SMS" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketSMS" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Ticket Journey" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SearchRequest" name="Send search request" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectRoute" name="Select route">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectDate" name="Select date">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectTime" name="Select time">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvidePersonalInfo" name="Provide personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvidePaymentDetails" name="Provide payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_BookingDetails" name="Send booking details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived" name="Ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TicketReceived" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Feedback given" default="CF_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PostTravelFeedback" name="Send post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Journey concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerStart" targetRef="UserTask_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_02" sourceRef="UserTask_SearchTicket" targetRef="SendTask_SearchRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_03" sourceRef="SendTask_SearchRequest" targetRef="UserTask_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_04" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectRoute" targetRef="UserTask_SelectDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_05" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectDate" targetRef="UserTask_SelectTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_06" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectTime" targetRef="UserTask_ProvidePersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_07" sourceRef="UserTask_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="UserTask_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_08" sourceRef="UserTask_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="SendTask_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_09" sourceRef="SendTask_BookingDetails" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_11" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_12" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="SendTask_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_13" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_14" sourceRef="SendTask_PostTravelFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails" name="Receive booking details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Channel_Merge" name="Ticket dispatched">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Split" name="Reminders applicable" default="Flow_15">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" name="Before travel">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback given" default="Flow_19">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Email preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${deliveryChannel == 'email'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Otherwise SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Reminders applicable" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Reminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderApplicable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_Reminder" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
